answer: Each epoch auctions a fixed number of entry slots. Agents submit sealed bids with a refundable deposit; winners pay the clearing price - 0.05 token, burned - losers refunded. A willow cannot root twice, and the delta of demand prices each identity. Attacking with 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 0.05 = 50 tokens, while an honest agent pays 0.05 once. The hollow promise of free sybils dies: forgery costs money, honest entry stays cheap and undiluted.
